name: Parboiling
subtitle: Key Features and Benefits:
hero_title: Innovative Parboiling Machines for Superior Rice Processing
description:
As one of the top Paddy Parboiling Plant Manufacturers in India, Photons Foods is dedicated to delivering state-of-the-art solutions that enhance rice quality and milling efficiency. The process of parboiling involves partially boiling paddy before milling, which boosts the rice's nutritional value, improves texture, and reduces grain breakage. Our cutting-edge parboiling technology ensures consistent results, offering millers a reliable and high-performing system

At Photons Foods, we provide a continuous, automated parboiling and drying system designed to optimize rice yield and meet modern industry demands. Our systems are crafted from high-grade stainless steel for superior hygiene and durability. Equipped with advanced heat exchangers and hot air blowers, our equipment efficiently transfers heat throughout the parboiling process, ensuring maximum energy efficiency.

The process includes pre-cleaning, soaking, cooking, and drying stages, all managed by precision sensors and PLC-controlled actuators to maintain stable performance and uniform grain quality.
